title: feat(inline styles): add extra keys to allow inline styles styling
body:
After a lot of back and forth this PR include: 
- New theme keys to allow a real usage of inline styles/Aphrodite/And co.
- New method to extend a theme by using only inline style
- A new styling guide

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @Morhaus, @vvo and @bobylito to be potential reviewers

As a user, can I use CSS modules with webpack (css/style loaders) and use the theme property to provide that theme?

If so in tooling we could just say that yes this is doable, with a simple example code (no webpack, just import theme from css).
Yes It's possible. But for me it belongs to the react-themeable function. And then it's a C/C of theirs docs no ? And why not do that for other ways ?
And I added the fix for the doc in prod.
